tb21_profile.domain: iCalendar/ICS, datetime and UTC arithmetic, interval overlap, constraint satisfaction / resolver search

SWE-Smith-Seeds-Clean.reason: .at() drops the hour and minute so jobs fire at the wrong time; time-of-day arithmetic is exactly what slot selection depends on.
until() mishandles a string end time; bounding a schedule by a deadline, the same window-endpoint reasoning.
utcnow returns local time instead of UTC; the exact UTC-versus-local confusion that would break the required Z-suffixed output.
Timezone-aware construction is broken; getting a datetime into the right zone before comparing it to a window.
12-hour tokens render 13:00 wrongly; the AM/PM boundary errors that wreck a 9 AM-6 PM window check.
Granularity-based time deltas computed wrongly; duration arithmetic between two instants, as in a one-hour slot.
Scheduler fails to validate the time unit, so bad schedules blow up later; validating a schedule specification up front.
Multi-format datetime parsing returns None; parsing timestamps out of text, the DTSTART/DTEND step here.
Range check uses strict instead of inclusive inequality; the inclusive/exclusive boundary bug that makes a slot wrongly valid.
Datetime addition via __radd__ broken; adding a duration to an instant, the operation that turns a start time into an end time.

todoman stores todos as iCalendar files; round-tripping non-ASCII fields through .ics without corrupting them.
A relational expression is accepted as an objective and silently sent to the solver; distinguishing constraints from objectives when modelling.
Adding an extra constraint to an indexed model errors out; constructing a constraint set correctly over an index space.
Presolve reports the wrong degrees of freedom; reasoning about how many constraints actually pin a model, i.e. feasibility bookkeeping.
Bound propagation over squares written as products; interval/bound tightening, the core pruning technique in constraint search.
Indexed SOS1 constraints fail to reach the solver; expressing an at-most-one selection constraint, the shape of a slot choice.
Cached iCalendar collection metadata is never refreshed; reading a directory of .ics files as the source of truth.
Beat's persistent schedule database gets corrupted; maintaining a schedule's stored state, adjacent rather than central.

notes: The ICS half of this task is essentially absent from the pool: a regex for .ics/VEVENT/VCALENDAR/iCalendar matched exactly one real task pool-wide (collective__icalendar-878), plus the todoman pair which stores todos as iCalendar. I ranked that one high on domain despite its bug-fix form because nothing else touches the format. The constraint-search half is well covered, but only in TMax, and not by the retrievers: TMax has a large cluster of dependency/version resolver tasks that are structurally identical to this problem (enumerate a discrete space, reject candidates violating any hard constraint, then apply a stated preference to pick among survivors), and I found them with a 'satisfies all|constraint solver|feasible' regex rather than from the shortlist. The datetime-arithmetic half maps onto SWE-Smith's arrow and schedule clusters (UTC-vs-local, AM/PM boundaries, inclusive ranges, duration addition), which is why SWE-Smith scores better here than its task_form would suggest. RTS and TerminalWorld are weak: their apparent 'schedule' and 'timezone' matches are cron-job and system-locale boilerplate, which I discounted; what I kept are Taskwarrior due-date entries, windowed stream joins, a room-allocation system and a symbolic constraint solve.
